review:
Birds On A Wire is a cult Thunderkick slot where birds on electrified wires get zapped. It features dropping symbols, High Voltage multipliers, the Inwinity Spin and free spins.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 9,000x cap and a 96.1% RTP. Dark humour and strong features.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
